detail.recheck_hint: Bind the missing assets, then recheck — no need to wait for the sweep
detail.acceptance_empty: No acceptance spec on the work item
detail.mapping_desc: How workflow objects line up with project objects
detail.mapping_template: Template definition → the compiled stage snapshots of an instance
detail.mapping_instance: Instance → project + work item (root issue) + sprint
detail.mapping_stage: Stage run → agent task + its comments on the work item
detail.mapping_gate: Gate run → the stage it guards + decision rounds
detail.mapping_acceptance: Acceptance spec → work item criteria + acceptance round
detail.mapping_binding: Landed output → project asset binding (asset management module)
detail.mapping_sprint: Sprint → the iteration the instance is bound to
detail.mapping_goal: Goal → instance goal + per-stage goal (spec snapshot)
detail.mapping_admission: Admission rule → stage required asset keys (gate_doc_types)
detail.rendered_hint: Rendered into the task prompt comment on dispatch
